title: River of Blood
start: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace throne room.

items.t: Guthix balance potion or flask (any dose)
Any weapon that can harm Vampyres (e.g. Blisterwood weaponry)
Blisterwood polearm (Craft another one if you want to use the polearm for combat. This one will be given to an NPC)

recommended.t: 65 Agility for Paterdomus to Morytania shortcut
Invitation box or Skeletal horror Teleport for easy teleport to Paterdomus
Fang of Mohegan (if owned) for teleport to Nature Grotto

rewards.t: Tome of XP 5th ed, which contains three chapters worth 75,000 experience each, redeemable on a skill equal to or higher than level 75
A Sunspear (melee), which can be changed into a Sunspear (magic) and Sunspear (ranged), along with a cosmetic override of each accessible via the Customisation interface.
Ability to make blood essences by talking to Vanescula Drakan on the roof of Castle Drakan.

steps.t: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. [Chat: 1 Talk about River of Blood. › Accept]
Talk to Drezel in the Paterdomus mausoleum west of Canifis (fairy ring CKS, invitation box or Skeletal horror Teleport for quick access). [Chat: 2 Talk about something else. › ~]

sub.t: Reclaim the wolfbane dagger if you had previously destroyed it.

steps.t: Talk to Aeonisig south of the temple. You can use the invitation box to get there. Otherwise, exit the building on the west side and head towards the beacon (or exit east side and use agility shortcut). He is at the bottom of the stairs.
Defeat the 3 Vyrewatches using blisterwood weapons.
Talk to Aeonisig. [Chat: Any › 4 Farewell.]
Talk to Captain Rovin (one of the three guards slightly north east) to supply him with armour.
Kill all Zamorak monks in the temple - you can use any combat style/gear here.
Kill the Zamorakian leader and bodyguard on the top floor - you can use any combat style/gear here.
Talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum.
Return and talk to Aeonisig. Go through all the chat options. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Drezel. [Chat: 2 Talk About something else]
Climb-down the nearby trapdoor.

sub.t: If the trapdoor isn't open, use the temple library key (obtainable from Drezel) on the keyhole.

steps.t: Pull 7 books off the bookcases in the correct order until you find the Blood of the Covenant:
Read the book.
Climb-up the ladder.
Talk to Ivan Strom.
Enter the trapdoor behind Canifis pub, search the southern wall in the room and take the first cave entrance on the east side of the tunnel.

sub.t: If players are taken to Mort'ton they need to go to the Temple Trekking noticeboard next to the temple west of Canifis, click on the medium NPC and on the right hand side, they'll see the NPC with level 99, which is rewarded with the ability to toggle a shortcut from the trapdoor. After toggling it the door will function as normal or the boat can be taken back to the swamp and run to the cellar doors from here to access the tomb without toggling the function.

steps.t: Use a Guthix balance on the tomb and open it. [Chat: 1]
Open the scroll case and read the Scroll of Balance.
Burn a Blisterwood log and take the ashes. They spawn immediately upon lighting the fire.
Grind the silvthril bar at the ectofuntus grinder. [Chat: 1]
Use the silvthril dust on the Altar of Nature in the Nature Grotto.
Use any of the three ingredients on a super restore (3) to make a super Guthix balance potion. Keep the Ivandis's serum in your inventory for later use.
Talk to Drezel. [Chat: 2 Talk about something else.]
Pour the Super Guthix balance into the well in the main room to the west.

Talk to Aeonisig south of the church. [Chat: 3 About equipping the Varrock guard... › 2 About claiming the Paterdomus temple... › Any › 1 About strengthening the Salve barrier... › 3 I should investigate this.]
Talk to Vanescula on the bridge. [Chat: Any › Any]

sub.t: Use the the broken Saradomin statue shortcut to the east if you have 65 Agility or teleport to the fairy ring CKS.

steps.t: Kill the feral vampyres.
Kill the Wyrd while stepping away from its special attacks.

sub.t: The Sonic Wave attack deals 7,500 damage when praying melee. Otherwise, it will deal 15,000 damage. This can be avoided by stepping at least two squares back. It is also important to note that if you step off the bridge at any time you will have to redo the fight.

steps.t: Talk to Ivan Strom on the bridge over the salve river.
Travel to Burgh de Rott via Drakan's medallion. [Chat: 2]
Travel on the boat south of Burgh de Rott to the Icyene graveyard. [Chat: 2 Icyene graveyard.]
Talk to Efaritay.
Inspect the Queen Efaritay statue within the northern crypt, and take the pendant.
Talk to Efaritay.
Craft a Blisterwood shaft from blisterwood logs.
Use the shaft on the sunspear with the wolfbane dagger and blisterwood shaft in your inventory.
Talk to Efaritay.
Teleport to the Meiyerditch Laboratories via Drakan's medallion. [Chat: 5]
Talk to Sarius.
Run through the tunnel to the room with the mutated bloodveld.
Take the book from the research table on the north side and read it.
Talk to Sarius.
Climb the stairs and run north-west into the mine.
With your vampyre disguise on, talk to a guard about the refinery. (if you don't have your disguise on you must manually fill the cart up with 15 ores yourself)
Talk to one of the Juvinate guards. [Chat: 1 Where's the daeyalt refinery?]
Push the cart.
Kill the juvinates.
Open the 5 cell doors.
Run north and talk to Emilia. [Chat: 5 Let the anger flow through you.]
Talk to Sorin. [Chat: 4 Isn't this technology awesome?]
Talk to Ileana. [Chat: 3 I don't approve of this, and neither should you.]
Talk to Razvan. [Chat: 2 You should be ashamed. Have you no remorse?]
Talk to Florin. [Chat: 1 Cheer up. Don't give up hope.]
Tithe the Shadum blood lock located on the south western part of the wall. [Chat: 6 I accept my fate and put my hand in the machine.]
p: Pouring the Guthix balance onto the Ivandis's tomb

steps.t: Extract the refined daeyalt from the refined daeyalt mine.
Inspect the rejuvenation tank.
Climb the stairs and talk to Safalaan.
Kill the Skeleton Hellhounds.
Climb the stairs.
On the northern end of the room, go into the eastern door into a long, narrow hallway.
Go into the Library through a door on the southern wall of the hallway.
Take the bottle of holy water from the table (red dot on the map).
Continue east through the narrow hallway.
Throw the bottle of holy water on Harold and climb the stairs.
p: Killing Harold with the bottle of holy water
The Stone of Jas and a blisterwood tree

steps.t: Cut a log from the blisterwood tree.
Light the firepit in front of the Stone of Jas. It is a small black ring immediately in front of the stone, easy to miss.
Roll the barrel of gunpowder.
Unlock the blood seal in the northern room.
Climb the stairs.
Defeat Safalaan with the Sunspear.
Talk to Efaritay.
Use the daeyalt and Ivandis' serum on Safalaan's blood.
Talk to Efaritay.
Pour the extreme Guthix balance potion into the Paterdomus well.
p: Blessing the Salve with the extreme Guthix balance potion

steps.t: Talk to Vanescula on the bridge.
Watch the cutscene and then talk to Vanescula once more.
Talk to King Roald. [Chat: 1 Talk about River of Blood.]
Quest complete!

p: The Vampyre Juvinates become feral vampyres.
Speaking to Efaritay at the icyenic graveyard
The battle with Safalaan atop Castle Drakan
